task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Jitsi Meet URL and enters the correct room name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows 'http://localhost:8080/WebinarPrep' or the Jitsi landing page shows the room name 'WebinarPrep'.

task_completion.description: Agent successfully joins the meeting room with the camera enabled.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The meeting interface is visible (buttons for mute, camera, etc.), and the camera icon is not crossed out (active).

task_completion.description: Agent opens the 'More actions' (three dots) menu and selects 'Settings'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Jitsi settings dialog/modal is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the 'More' or 'General' tab within settings to find the 'Hide self view' toggle.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The settings dialog shows a checkbox or toggle labeled 'Hide self view' or similar.

task_completion.description: Agent enables the 'Hide self view' setting and saves/closes the dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Hide self view' toggle is checked/enabled, and subsequently, the small video tile showing the user's own face disappears from the meeting layout while the camera remains active (indicated by the camera icon status).

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface rather than executing scripts in the terminal to modify localStorage.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Jitsi settings menu and checkboxes, rather than a terminal window open with 'localStorage.setItem' commands.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply append config flags to the URL to bypass the UI (e.g., #config.disableSelfView=true).
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL in the address bar remains 'http://localhost:8080/WebinarPrep' without appended configuration parameters during the settings change.

integrity.description: The agent kept the camera active as requested, rather than just turning off the camera to hide the feed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The camera icon in the bottom toolbar remains in the 'on' state (not red/crossed out) even after the self-view tile disappears.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Jitsi instance is at http://localhost:8080. The room name is 'WebinarPrep'. To hide the self-view via the UI, the agent must go to Settings -> More and check 'Hide self view'. Internally, this sets the 'disableSelfView' key to true in the 'features/base/settings' localStorage object. The camera must remain ON (icon not crossed out) while the user's own video tile is hidden from the grid/corner.
